scope: 870 currently included papers; multi-label assignments overlap.
method: Controlled English topic labels manually assigned from paper titles and existing verified contribution summaries. Ambiguous modality and method claims omitted. Topics are not mutually exclusive.

topics.name: MRI
topics.definition: Magnetic resonance imaging is explicitly an input, target, or evaluated modality.

topics.name: CT
topics.definition: Computed tomography is explicitly used as an input, output, or evaluation modality.

topics.name: X-ray
topics.definition: Radiographs, mammograms, or X-ray projections are explicitly used.

topics.name: Ultrasound
topics.definition: Ultrasound or echocardiography is explicitly used.

topics.name: Endoscopy
topics.definition: Endoscopic or colonoscopic imagery, including polyp analysis and endoscope tracking.

topics.name: Pathology
topics.definition: Histology, histopathology, whole-slide images, or clinical tissue-slide analysis.

topics.name: Retinal imaging
topics.definition: Retinal, fundus, ophthalmic OCT, or optic-disc/cup image analysis.

topics.name: Microscopy
topics.definition: Microscopic image acquisition, cellular imaging, or microscopy restoration beyond a generic whole-slide classification label.

topics.name: Medical segmentation
topics.definition: Pixel-, voxel-, mesh-, cell-, or instance-level delineation of medical structures.

topics.name: Registration & motion tracking
topics.definition: Spatial registration, correspondence, lesion tracking, or medical motion estimation.

topics.name: Image reconstruction
topics.definition: Recovering images from measurements or degraded data, including super-resolution and restoration; not merely decoding learned representations.

topics.name: Image synthesis
topics.definition: Generating, translating, virtually staining, or interpolating medical images or cellular layouts.

topics.name: Diagnosis & detection
topics.definition: Disease classification, diagnostic reasoning, abnormality detection, clinical grading, or medical object/landmark detection.

topics.name: Report generation
topics.definition: Generating medical image reports or summaries of clinical radiology reports.

topics.name: Medical VQA
topics.definition: Answering questions grounded in medical images.

topics.name: Clinical NLP
topics.definition: Clinical language modeling, medical text understanding, concept normalization, entity extraction, or text simplification.

topics.name: EHR prediction
topics.definition: Clinical outcome or health-state modeling using patient records, clinical measurements, or electronic health records.

topics.name: Survival prediction
topics.definition: Estimating survival outcomes or survival time, including multimodal pathology/genomics models.

topics.name: Drug discovery
topics.definition: Therapeutic molecule/antibody design, drug-response or pharmacokinetic modeling, repurposing, or drug-interaction prediction.

topics.name: Medication & treatment recommendation
topics.definition: Selecting medications, optimizing treatment policies, or recommending clinical procedures.

topics.name: Genomics & transcriptomics
topics.definition: Gene expression, genetic biomarkers, tumor genomes, or image–genomics modeling is a substantive part of the work.

topics.name: Surgical AI
topics.definition: Surgical workflow recognition, skill assessment, operating-room understanding, or intraoperative navigation.

topics.name: Physiological monitoring
topics.definition: Estimating physiological signals, pulse, blood flow, or quantitative physiological measurements.

topics.name: Mental health
topics.definition: Mental-health screening or assessment is an explicit application.

topics.name: Dentistry
topics.definition: Dental, tooth, orthodontic, or oral radiograph analysis.

topics.name: Dermatology & wounds
topics.definition: Skin disease, skin-lesion analysis, psoriasis severity, or wound assessment and reconstruction.

topics.name: Neuroimaging & neurological assessment
topics.definition: Brain imaging, neurological disease assessment, neural decoding, or neurodevelopmental assessment.

topics.name: Federated learning
topics.definition: Collaborative model learning across institutions without pooling the original data, including decentralized/distributed learning.

topics.name: Privacy & security
topics.definition: Privacy guarantees, distributed data protection, medical-model attacks, or re-identification/privacy analysis.

topics.name: Explainability
topics.definition: Interpretable concepts, localized explanations, feature attribution, or human correction of model decisions.

topics.name: Causal inference
topics.definition: Explicit causal effect estimation, causal graphical modeling, confounding control, or causal intervention/adjustment.

topics.name: Domain adaptation & generalization
topics.definition: Cross-domain/site/modality adaptation, domain generalization, distribution-shift handling, or an explicit study of transferable medical representations.

topics.name: Self-supervised learning
topics.definition: Explicit pretraining or learning from unlabeled signals using self-supervised/unsupervised representation objectives.

topics.name: Semi-supervised learning
topics.definition: Joint use of labeled and unlabeled examples is an explicit method component.

topics.name: Weakly supervised learning
topics.definition: Learning from coarse, sparse, slide-level, image-level, or otherwise weak labels, including multiple-instance learning.

topics.name: Medical vision-language models
topics.definition: Joint medical image–text representation learning, multimodal foundation models, or language-grounded visual reasoning.

topics.name: Neural architecture search
topics.definition: Automated search over medical network architectures or topology.

topics.name: Anatomical modeling
topics.definition: Explicit anatomical geometry, surface, shape-template, or deformable-tissue modeling.

topics.name: Assistive & biomedical technology
topics.definition: Medical devices, neuroprosthetic decoding, vision testing, bioprinting, or healthcare-device reconstruction.

topics.name: Disease progression
topics.definition: Longitudinal disease forecasting, progression representations, or disease-evolution modeling.

topics.name: Public health & clinical research
topics.definition: Epidemic control or clinical-trial recruitment and research operations.

topics.name: Cell biology
topics.definition: Cellular processes, single-cell biology, and experimental cellular protocols.

topics.name: Protein modeling
topics.definition: Protein structure, sequence, function, interactions, or design.

topics.name: Neuroscience
topics.definition: Empirical or computational study of neural systems, cognition, or model-organism behavior.

topics.name: Visual neuroscience
topics.definition: Human visual perception and its neural representations.

topics.name: Medical reasoning
topics.definition: Medical reasoning research explicitly supported by source review.

topics.name: Data & evaluation
topics.definition: Data & evaluation research explicitly supported by source review.
